digest.component_or_area: Ruff linting configuration and timezone semantics
propositions: Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families must be enabled globally and produce zero diagnostics across src/rebar and tests.

Integer epoch timestamps and timezone-less persisted timestamp strings must be converted to UTC-aware datetimes using datetime.timezone.utc before clustering, with behavior verified under multiple TZ environment values on POSIX/macOS platforms.

Security-rule cadence determination must obtain an aware current instant with explicit timezone argument, convert to host timezone, and extract the local calendar date while passing DTZ005 compliance.
Production Python files in src/rebar must not contain the literal datetime.UTC token; only datetime.timezone.utc is permitted for py310 target version.
All 6 existing Ruff ASYNC/DTZ diagnostics across src/rebar and tests must be remedied before the rule families are added to the gated configuration.
The exact Ruff security selector S, .semgrep.yml, .semgrep.yaml, and .semgrep/ directory must not be present in the codebase.
